fields.description: Profile/system name stored as Shift-JIS (2 bytes per kana). Rev8-logical bytes decode to 'Shisutaa Purinsesu 202' followed by NUL padding; the same bytes are garbled in the raw (non-reversed) domain, proving eeprom_rev8 domains.
fields.evidence: Rev8-logical offsets 0x00-0x17 of samples/baseline.sav decode via Shift-JIS to the katakana system name plus ' 202'. The EEPROM serial save routines lie outside the decompiled slice (ROM 0x080005e4-0x0801af14, no 0x0Dxxxx bus or 0x02xxxxxx RAM-save-struct symbols); closest in-slice data-movement primitive is FUN_0800e8e0 (DMA3 word copies via 0x040000d4-0x040000dc).
fields.name: profile_name

fields.description: Slot 0 status marker: 0x9C in the populated slot, 0xA6 in unpopulated slots/footer. Values are state codes, not checksums (slots 1/2 and footer share 0xA6 over differing data).
fields.evidence: Rev8-logical offset 0x27 == 0x9C in samples/baseline.sav while slots 1/2 and footer hold 0xA6; save routines outside decompiled slice, closest in-slice primitive FUN_0800e8e0.
